summary_en: NAKABAYASHI executed a block trade to acquire 260,000 shares (0.96% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 515 yen per share on November 9, 2026, for a total of 133.9 million yen under its existing repurchase authorization of up to 1 million shares and 600 million yen through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, NAKABAYASHI's Board of Directors authorized an execution of share repurchase under an existing authorization framework. The company proceeded to acquire 260,000 shares of its own common stock on November 9, 2026, through off-hours block trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at a fixed price of 515 yen per share, representing the closing price (including after-hours trading quotations) on the authorization date. The aggregate acquisition amount totaled 133.9 million yen.

This execution represented 0.96% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock. The shares were acquired under a broader repurchase authorization approved by the Board on the same date, which permits the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares for a maximum of 600 million yen during the period from November 9, 2026, through March 31, 2027, through on-market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 transactions. The company stated the purpose of the repurchase as part of its capital allocation strategy to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.

Results of the transaction were to be publicly disclosed following the conclusion of trading on November 9, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. The company noted that acquisition was subject to market conditions and the possibility existed that all or part of the order might not be executed.
